name: Microsoft Entra ID public tenant discovery (OpenID configuration, GetUserRealm, Office ODC federation provider)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); 'Microsoft public identity endpoints: tier trusted, terms open' (P011 chair rationale).

personal_data_review.basis: P011 cond 1-3 (legal_dpo floor): domain-level endpoints only; e-mail inputs are reduced to their domain before any request and the only local part ever sent is the fixed, documented probe constant 'nonexistent.realm.probe' (unit-test asserted), so Microsoft never receives an e-mail address; no user-level oracle (GetCredentialType, Autodiscover, OneDrive/Teams/login checks) can be built in code.

reliability.justification: Authoritative first-party answers of Microsoft's identity platform for the queried domain; the federation brand name is tenant-admin text (self-declared) and unmanaged/test tenants can claim a domain without DNS proof (observed for example.com on 2026-11-26), so ownership needs DNS confirmation.

openid.title: OpenID configuration login.microsoftonline.com/{domain}/.well-known/openid-configuration (tenant GUID, tenant_region_scope)
openid.notes: Research C0517. One call per registrable seed domain (P011 cond 4). HTTP 400 {'error': 'invalid_tenant', 'error_codes': [90002]} (AADSTS90002) means no Entra ID tenant (EMPTY); cache-control max-age=86400.

getuserrealm.title: GetUserRealm login.microsoftonline.com/getuserrealm.srf with the fixed probe local part (NameSpaceType, FederationBrandName, federation AuthURL)
getuserrealm.notes: Research C0517. Domain-level only: login=nonexistent.realm.probe@{domain}, a hard-coded non-existent local part (P011 cond 1-2); never a real user, never iterated. Called only after the OpenID configuration found a tenant (P011 cond 4). NameSpaceType 'Unknown' = no Entra ID tenant. The federated AuthURL query echoes the probe login and is dropped.

odc.title: Office ODC federation provider odc.officeapps.live.com/odc/v2.1/federationprovider?domain= (tenant id, environment)
odc.notes: Research C0033. Called only after a tenant was found (P011 cond 4). No tenant = HTTP 200 with the usual keys and no tenantId (observed for example.invalid); any other shape is ERROR 'schema changed', never EMPTY. Technique re-implemented from Microsoft's public endpoint (bbot is AGPL: nothing copied, A6).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-2 (P011, module m365_tenant). Rule 2: user-level oracles (GetCredentialType, Autodiscover user checks, OneDrive/Teams/login checks) are never wired; the module builds only the three domain-level URLs above (allow-list asserted by tests). Both hosts set cookies, which the core client never stores or replays.
